code:
Create   -- insert a new record
Read     -- view existing records
Edit     -- update existing records
Delete   -- remove records

View All   -- Read, every record, bypasses sharing
Modify All -- Edit+Delete, every record, bypasses sharing
caption: CRUD is independent per permission -- Read+Edit without Create is common.
The real matrix -- CRUD plus View All / Modify All, per permission set group.
Custom profiles can be edited; standard profiles' CRUD settings are locked.

subtitle: The mandatory baseline every CRUD setting lives on.
